item.description: Health workers battling the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo are hindered by lack of data, budget cuts and a fearful community.

item.title: Alberta voters decide whether to take a step toward separating from Canada
item.description: In Canada, the oil-rich province of Alberta votes in a referendum that could set it on a path toward separation, as Prime Minister Mark Carney warns of threats to Canadian unity.

item.title: In Dublin, tech workers raise concerns about AI
item.description: Dublin, Ireland, is a longtime hub for American tech companies. A group of workers held a summit to discuss their concerns about AI in Irish workplaces and life.

item.title: Elizabeth Holmes documentary 'You Can See Everything' has audiences filling theaters
item.description: Theater owners are clamoring to book You Can See Everything in additional locations after a very successful opening weekend. It's had the second best opening ever for a non-music documentary.
